info.title: Hexspare Tally public API
info.description: Implemented developer API. All data calls use a project API key. Dataset fields describe the Standard pack; actual customer schemas and privacy rules are connection-specific. GET /v1/connections/{id}/schema returns {version,bundleHash,datasets,openapi}; extract openapi for that connection. x-required-scope identifies the exact API-key scope, with no scope inheritance. Real TallyPrime validation is still pending; see the application guide.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque nextCursor from a synced list; ignored in live mode.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum records returned.

parameters.name: updatedSince
parameters.description: Synced mode only: records updated strictly after this timestamp.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Synced mode only: comma-separated top-level fields; identity and metadata remain.

parameters.name: live
parameters.description: Ask the online connector and Tally directly. Live lists have no cursor pagination; check truncated.

parameters.name: includeDeleted
parameters.description: Synced mode only: include deletion tombstones.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Live date-paged datasets only. Defaults to the start of the current UTC month.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Live date-paged datasets only. Defaults to day 31 of the current UTC month.

200.description: Synced or live records. updatedAt and deleted are synced metadata. Live responses add truncated.

X-Tally-Last-Sync.description: Last sync across the connection; omitted before the first sync.

default.description: API error. See error.code and error.message.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique within the project. Reusing it with a different connection, action, record or body returns 409.

202.description: Job accepted; poll its status or subscribe to write_job events. Acceptance does not mean Tally has posted it.

Idempotent-Replay.description: true when returning an existing job

default.description: API error. See error.code and error.message.
